items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Will Morrissey used to -- when I lived on 127th Street, he used to come up to my house, knock on the door at 4:00 in the morning, he and his wife.

ctx.x: Red Hot Harlem, that was it. Red Hot Harlem. That was back in -- it was around '28 or '29, '25, '27. Will Morrissey used to -- when I lived on 127th Street, he used to come up to my house, knock on the door at 4:00 in the morning, he and his wife. Li'l woman.
